notes.itemTitle: Upload your CV for the Kraft Heinz CV book
notes.title: Kraft Heinz wants your CV
notes.body: The CDC is collecting CVs from everyone who attended today's Kraft Heinz session, and the form closes Monday 09:00 CET. That is 13:30 your time, in the middle of your first Business Foundations class. - Do it on Sunday instead; the form link is in your calendar.
acted: Added a career task for the Kraft Heinz CV book, due Monday 16 November, and put the deadline in your calendar with the upload link.

notes.itemTitle: Submit the visa application at VFS New Delhi
notes.title: Your passport is coming back
notes.body: VFS says the embassy has finished with your application and sent it back to the Delhi centre this morning. They will email you when it is ready to collect. - The decision is made either way now, so tell Marie Rose as soon as you have it.
